title: Gauge
description: One headline number measured against a floor, ceiling, or goal, with a bar showing where it sits and whether it passes.
x-use-when: A single metric judged against a threshold or target: margin vs a policy floor, GP attainment vs quota, fill rate vs target, days to ship vs a maximum.
x-dont-use-when: There is no threshold or target (use kpi), several values need comparing (use bar_chart), or the metric's history matters more than where it stands now (use line_chart with a reference line).
x-checks: Warns when a percent value, target, or range looks like a whole number (45 instead of 0.45).
Error when range.min is not below range.max.
Warns when the value or target falls outside range (the bar is clipped).
Warns when warning_within is set on a goal (it only applies to floors and ceilings).

value.description: The metric as a raw number. Use null when there is no data and explain why in note.

format.description: How value, target, and range are displayed. percent expects fractions: 0.15 shows as 15%.

target.description: The threshold the value is judged against.

value.description: The threshold as a raw number in the same format as value, e.g. 0.08 for an 8% floor.

kind.description: floor: at or above is good, below fails (margin floor). ceiling: at or below is good, above fails (max days to ship). goal: progress toward a number; reaching it is good, falling short is shown as progress, not failure (quota).

label.description: Name of the threshold, e.g. "KPA policy floor" or "Q4 quota". Default: the kind ("floor", "ceiling", "goal").

warning_within.description: Floors and ceilings only: how close to the threshold, on the passing side, counts as a warning, in the value's units. 0.02 with an 8% floor makes 8% to 10% amber.

range.description: Optional scale for the bar. Default: 0 to a round number above the value and target.
